name: Car Track
description: Design printable track for 1:64 die-cast cars (the orange Hot Wheels-style channel): straights, curves, ramps and loops that chain end to end, connectors that clip pieces together, supports, Split to fit for your printer, and a Test drive that runs a car over the track (loops, ramps, jumps) to find the launch speed it needs. Install 3D Print as well to download the pieces.
author: MatthiasDM
